sentence: 金の切れ目が縁の切れ目。
translation: The end of money is the end of love.

furigana.text: 金の切れ目が縁の切れ目
furigana.annotation: かねのきれめがえんのきれめ

ichiran.reading: 金の切れ目が縁の切れ目 【かねのきれめがえんのきれめ】
ichiran.text: 金の切れ目が縁の切れ目
ichiran.kana: かねのきれめがえんのきれめ

gloss.gloss: relationships formed by wealth will end when the money ends; the relationship ends when the money runs out; the end of money is the end of love
